note: Independent re-judgment after BGP export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified RFC 8669 Section 3.1 ('Flags: 16 bits of flags. None are defined by this document. The Flags field MUST be clear on transmission'), attribute.EncodePrefixSID, session_prefix_sid.go (clearLabelIndexTLVs), and all four tagged units. TestRFC8669LabelIndexTransmissionClearsReservedAndFlags switched only its rfc8669RelayUpdate argument from NextHopUnchanged to policychain.BuiltinNextHopUnchanged, keeping all 6 writer/relay rails and clean/dirty assertions identical. Q1: bare and SRGB-form config encoders assert exact Flags=0x0000; TestClearTransmittedLabelIndexOnlyOnLabeledUnicast asserts zeroing Flags=0x5aff on IPv4/IPv6 labeled unicast (both attribute orders, 0 allocs) while leaving VPN/unicast untouched; TestRFC8669LabelIndexTransmissionClearsReservedAndFlags sends clean (0x0000) and dirty (0x5aff) Flags across all 6 rails (raw, packet, parsed, override, general, route-server) and asserts exact cleared wire bytes without mutating borrowed source or Originator SRGB. Q2: non-zero Flags emitted by either encoder or escaping any of the 6 writer/relay rails fails exact byte assertions. Q3: isolates Label-Index Flags clearing on labeled unicast while checking unknown TLV, SRGB, NLRI, and source immutability. Q4: covers origination and relay/transmission across IPv4/IPv6 labeled unicast and all writer rails.
